scope: Read-only application analysis; benchmarks on a copied database; no schedule mutations

server.method: One local app.inject GET and SQL query on a copied database; week payload is a proposed projection, not an implemented endpoint; no schedule writes

browser.method: One warm-browser load and one teacher-card selection per group; copied DB, no lesson writes

sqlExperiment.query:
SELECT l.id,l.teacher_ref,l.room_ref,s.start_minute,s.duration,d.group_id
FROM schedule_days d JOIN schedule_slots s ON s.day_id=d.id JOIN lessons l ON l.slot_id=s.id
WHERE d.date=? AND (l.teacher_ref=? OR l.room_ref=?)

sqlExperiment.method: Same-date teacher/room occupancy query, 3 runs; experimental indexes in copied DB, not installed in application

proposedBoundaries.bootstrap: catalogue, school settings, quarter list and versions without lessons or archive deletion blockers
proposedBoundaries.week: selected group/week geometry, lessons and scoped quarter counters
proposedBoundaries.placementPreview: one request for all visible cells; checks teacher/room occupancy on affected dates, rules and resolved room; includes revision
proposedBoundaries.command: atomic add/move/swap/edit/delete with requestId and revision; persist touched rows and return patches/counters
proposedBoundaries.bulkOperations: explicit date/group scope; heavy generation in a background job with progress

migrationOrder: Server command validation and selective reads with equivalence checks against existing rules
Switch manual editor to bootstrap + week + placement preview + commands; bounded undo and stale-request handling
Move copy, joint lessons, replacements, calendar/bells and clearing to scoped transactions
Server aggregation for load, then background generation and publication/printing improvements
mustPreserve: teacher and room overlaps by actual time, across groups/shifts
joint lesson mirrors and partial deletion
unavailability, suitable room type/capacity, room priority
plans, archived entries and unchanged legacy conflicts
teacher replacement origins and return behaviour
atomic writes, CSRF, same-origin, optimistic revision checks, idempotent retries

acceptanceTargets.measurementStatus: targets for the next implementation, not achieved endpoint timings
acceptanceTargets.preview: p95 <= 300 ms on local reference hardware and no multi-second browser task
acceptanceTargets.command: p95 <= 500 ms on local reference hardware for a single ordinary lesson
acceptanceTargets.initialEditorData: <= 200 KB excluding JS/CSS/images in this fixture
acceptanceTargets.correctness: equivalence to current rules for add/move/swap/edit/delete/undo/joints/absence and concurrent requests
